0022600001.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons in this matchup, with the Celtics on the road in Detroit, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives Boston a 50% chance to win. Six Celtics players are listed as day-to-day with rest and are game-time decisions: Derrick White, Mike Conley, Mitchell Robinson, Neemias Queta, Payton Pritchard and Sam Hauser. In 2025-26 the Celtics lost the season series 1-3, and their most recent meeting was a 104-103 loss in Detroit on January 19, 2026.
